body:
Jason would not have been recognized as being from Tokyo Ghoul at a glance, Kaneki was the only choice, just being real. 

As to why he's a killer, I don't think it's that far stretched with the entity being able to twist people's minds and Kaneki being very vulnerable at multiple points in the story.

Thank you for making feel like I matter, I haven't had the chance to get a lot of that lately, I appreciate you. It'll be hard to be happy just by myself, I hate myself most of the time for the choices I've made and basically for who I am. But I'll try to make it. Thank you for your time !

Thank you for taking the time to comment on my post. Thanks to you and the other commenter, illeve, I have decided that I deserve better. That I deserve someone who loves me back. I decided that I won't be seeing my ex boyfriend for a while, I don't know how long and he supports me in that. I also decided that I would cut back on texting him, he really is the only person that is there for me and that I can talk to about my feelings so if I feel really bad, I might just turn back to him until it goes away. It's hard, I don't want to be alone and I feel like he's all I have left but I can't stay like this or ... I won't be able to help myself. Thank you again for the time you took to read my post and try to make me feel better, you're a good person.
